--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,32 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+> **Note:** this repository does not contain any tests yet. The commands below describe the intended workflow; until test files are added, `pytest` will report "no tests ran".
+
+Tests are written with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/). The project has no dependency manifest, so install the runner directly — preferably inside a virtual environment:
+
+```bash
+python -m venv .venv
+source .venv/bin/activate
+pip install pytest
+```
+
+Run the full suite from the repository root:
+
+```bash
+python -m pytest
+```
+
+Running via `python -m pytest` (rather than the bare `pytest` command) puts the repository root on `sys.path`, so test modules can import `inventory_reconciliation`, `pricing_cache`, and `shipment_planner` directly.
+
+Useful variations:
+
+```bash
+python -m pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py   # a single file
+python -m pytest -k reconcile                  # tests whose name matches an expression
+python -m pytest -v                            # one line per test
+python -m pytest -x                            # stop at the first failure
+```
+
+New tests go in a `tests/` directory at the repository root, in files named `test_*.py`, with test functions named `test_*` — that is what pytest discovers by default.
